encoding_limitation: the registered licensing_table capability matches ONE compound construction key and can only emit reject_reconstruction for anything unmatched; the evidence-specific abstention reasons declared here are therefore DECLARED-BUT-UNREACHABLE pending a keyed-evidence capability — kept as the unit's honest abstention vocabulary, not as consumer behavior (audit finding, modeled on inc-atf-case-following)

licensing_table.note: analysis-dependent: the upstream account presents the carrier as fully vowel-determined, its tabulated and summary statements of the rule do not agree, and word-final position plus editorial convention are recorded as further conditioning factors

rules.text: the carrier is selected from the declared vowel environment by a precedence in which kasra outranks damma and damma outranks fatha; after a vowelless letter the hamza is bare
the carrier is a written-form fact, not a stem fact: it is re-evaluated after every affixation rather than copied from the citation form
hamza is a root consonant; membership in a hamza subclass is orthogonal to membership in a weak class and the two labels are never substituted
the stored forms — three initial-hamza imperatives and one irregular medial-hamza lexeme — are looked up before any derivation is attempted
carrier variants licensed by this table identify one token, not different entries; an unlisted environment abstains -> reject_reconstruction
